generations.prompt: Slow push-in to a medium close-up. {{VASCARI_LOCK}} He stands in a warm lamplit entry hall, his traveling case set on the floor beside him. A new lodger politely stating the single term of his lodging to the lady of the house, who is off frame, he speaks quietly, with unhurried old-world courtesy, in a low, faintly accented voice: "One condition. No one enters my room. Not even you." A pause. Then, softer, almost kindly: "Especially you." His expression is calm and courteous. Sound: rain muffled outside; a clock ticking somewhere; his low voice.
